title: Slugs keep a trailing hyphen
body: slugify('Blue Mug!') returns 'blue-mug-'. Punctuation at the end of a product name should not leave a hyphen behind.

title: Prices under ten pence are shown wrongly
body: format_pence(105) shows '£1.5' instead of '£1.05'. The pence part needs padding to two digits.

title: Cart discount takes off the wrong amount
body: A cart with a 10 percent discount on a 1000 pence order totals 100 pence, not 900. The cart and the pricing rules disagree about the unit of the discount.

title: Cannot buy the last items in stock
body: With 3 mugs in stock, adding 3 mugs to the cart should leave 0, but stock is not reserved for the full quantity and the stock check is off by one at the boundary.

title: Saturday is not treated as a weekend day
body: is_weekend returns False for Saturdays, so weekend delivery slots are offered at weekday rates. Looks like a boundary comparison is off by one.
